BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why is it that a lot of Americans don't vote? ASSISTANT:

There are a variety of reasons why a lot of Americans don't vote. Many cite a lack of interest or feeling that their vote won't make a difference. Others may be discouraged by the voting process or not be registered. Additionally, certain population groups may face barriers to voting due to socio-economic factors or language.
